description:
Problem: the guard added in PR #4203 covers run, compare and local MCP run_benchmark. These paths still reach a cloud platform without it: run --dry-run (reads credentials, can install a driver, and Databricks from_config calls WorkspaceClient and lists warehouses); setup --validate-only and --diagnose (connect, and a Snowflake SELECT 1 can resume a warehouse); durable start_benchmark (gated only by the remote allow-list, no acknowledgement plumbing); shell with an md: MotherDuck path; and run-official, which can acknowledge only through the environment variable. A terminal run proceeds with no prompt at all.

Outcome: an owner decision per path (guard it, or document why not), then the change.
